desc: Derive the per-index formula – proved that a subarray ending at `i` is valid iff it starts after `max1[i]`.
Implement the solution – write Python code for `Solution.maxSubarrays` using the described O(n) approach (pairs_by_right, scan with max1/max2, base + max_extra).
Test with provided examples – verify Example 1 returns 9 and Example 2 returns 12.
Edge case handling – ensure correct behavior for duplicate pairs, pairs where a > b, and minimum/maximum constraints.
Testing & validation – run brute-force cross-checks on random small instances and verify performance on max constraints (n=10^5, pairs=2n).
